sentences.text: Wellbore 15/9-F-11 T2 on Volve has 53 daily drilling reports, from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14.
No report is flagged as dated before spud, and the first unflagged report date is 2013-03-23.
The deepest measured depth in the reports is 4562.1 m, and Sodir gives a total depth of 4562 m for the parent wellbore, because Sodir does not list technical sidetracks.
Sodir lists the parent as an observation well with status P&A and a drilling completion date of 2013-05-12, while the reports continue to 2013-05-14.

The main outcome is that the well was drilled to total depth and logged with a wireline gyro run. It was then plugged back with cement and the last report records a kick-off to F-11 A, with operations transferred to that wellbore.
Primary lost time was 177.75 h, mostly waiting on weather, rig and riser equipment repairs, and waiting on cement.
Section 1 is a 26 in hole drilled from 2013-03-23 to 2013-04-12, from 257 m to 1365 m, with 1108 m of new hole.
The average rate while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration) was 16.0 m/h.
Section 2 is a 17.5 in hole drilled from 2013-04-13 to 2013-04-27, from 1368 m to 2577 m, with 1212 m of new hole.
The average rate while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration) was 14.87 m/h.
Section 3 is an 8.5 in hole drilled from 2013-04-28 to 2013-05-08, from 2577 m to 4562.1 m, with 1985.1 m of new hole.
The average rate while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration) was 14.0 m/h.

Section 4 has an unknown hole size because the reports do not state one for it (hole_size_source is unknown), although the bit evidence points to the 8.5 in size. It runs from 2013-05-09 to 2013-05-14, starts at 4562 m and drilled 0 m of new hole, covering the plug-back cementing and the cement kick-off. Its drilling rate is therefore unknown, since the tool gives no rate when no new hole is drilled.
Primary lost time by section was 72.5 h in section 1, 86.5 h in section 2 and 18.75 h in section 4, with none in section 3.
Primary lost time totals 177.75 h over 55 activities.
By cause, waiting on weather accounts for 74.0 h over 15 activities, repair for 71.0 h over 31 activities, and wait (riser test and repair stops, and waiting on cement) for 32.75 h over 9 activities.
Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 119.5 h over 56 activities, of which 104.75 h is in section 1, 7.0 h in section 2 and 7.75 h in section 3.

By code the possible time is 73.25 h coded interruption -- maintain and 46.25 h coded interruption -- other. These codes may or may not be lost time, and much of section 1 is the crown block sheave change-out and the gyro survey stops.

On 2013-03-24 the crew found the crown block fast-line sheave bearing seized onto its shaft while drilling section 1; the 4.0 h activity is coded interruption -- other (possible tier). The BHA was pulled and the sheave was changed out over the following days, mostly coded interruption -- maintain (possible tier).

On 2013-03-25 pulling the BHA out, a tight spot and overpull were recorded and a stand of drill pipe was mistakenly released from the elevators while still connected in the rotary; this 2.0 h activity is primary repair time.
On 2013-04-04, while running the surface casing string, a joint with damaged box threads was pulled, replaced and the backup wellhead assembly was prepared, costing 6.0 h of primary repair time.

Riser running had problems: on 2013-04-06 a riser flange could not be made up because the studs were too long (5.5 h, spacer washers fabricated), and on 2013-04-07 a riser connection test found a missing o-ring (6.0 h). Both are primary lost time, coded interruption -- wait.

The longest single stops were waiting on weather because cuttings could not be back-loaded to the supply vessel in heavy wind and sea: 16.0 h on 2013-04-15 and 15.5 h on 2013-04-19, within a weather-wait period that started on 2013-04-14.
On 2013-04-24 a drawworks failure was troubleshot for 5.0 h while the intermediate casing was being landed, coded as primary repair time.
On 2013-04-27 the SoundTrack MWD tool was troubleshot for 5.0 h after pulling the BHA to near surface, and further MWD decoding problems followed on 2013-04-28.

On 2013-05-08, after the wireline gyro run at total depth, the 8.5 in BHA took overpull and needed rotation to pass a restriction, with several tight spots on the trip out; this 5.25 h trip is coded drilling -- trip and carries no lost-time tier.
From 2013-05-10 the open hole was plugged back with cement. On 2013-05-11 a 12.25 h block of waiting on cement, used for a BOP pressure test, is primary lost time coded interruption -- wait.
On 2013-05-14 hard cement was tagged and drilled, the well was kicked off to F-11 A, and operations were transferred to that wellbore.

Weather waiting was the largest primary cause because cuttings back-loading to the supply vessel stopped in heavy sea, so the next well should plan more cuttings storage or an alternative disposal route, and a weather contingency before the open-hole sections start. This follows from the waiting-on-weather total of 74.0 h and the 16.0 h and 15.5 h stops in key events.

Rig equipment checks should be done before spud: the seized crown block sheave, the pipe handling machine faults, the drawworks failure and the MWD tool faults all interrupted drilling. The next well should carry out a crown block and pipe handling inspection and surface-test the MWD tools before running in hole, given primary repair time of 71.0 h.

Riser and casing hardware should be inspected and dimension-checked on the rig before running: a missing o-ring, over-long flange studs and a casing joint with damaged box threads each cost hours of primary lost time in section 1.

Section 1 also carried 104.75 h of possible lost time, so the next well should review whether its gyro survey stops and sheave work are planned time or lost time, and report them in separate categories.

Tight spots and overpull on the first trip out at total depth point to the next well conditioning the 8.5 in hole before a trip. The report data do not give a cause, so this is a recommendation to review hole cleaning and the wiper trip practice, not a finding.

Waiting on cement during the plug-back should be planned so that BOP testing and other rig work run in parallel from the start, and the daily report should label the BOP test activity separately from the wait.

row.comments:
Checked crown block fast-line sheave and found bearing ceased onto shaft. Evaluated situation and informed offshore and onshore managment. Prepared forward plan to POOH 26" BHA prior to working on fast-line sheave. Barriered off rig floor and cantelever.

Meanwhile:
Circulated well 1100 l/min, 8 bar, 20 RPM, 2 kNm. Attempted to apply lubricant to fast-line sheave.

Prepared POOH from bottom at 453 m. Installed grease pump in crown block. Oriented 26" steering BHA.  Displaced well to 1.35 sg KCl mud, 1100 - 3100 l/min, 8 - 70 bar. Confirmed barriered off rig floor and cantelever. POOH from 454 m, recorded overpull of 30 tons. Broke circulation 650 l/min, 10 bar, 40 RPM, 15 kNm. POOH up through tight spot from 454 to 438 m. Stand of 5 1/2" DP mistakenly released from elevators while still connected in rotary.
Prepared for changing out fast-line sheave in crown block. Visually inspected top drive, hung off top drive, rigged down wireline equipment.

Broke out wellhead from string and laid down same to deck.
Pulled out of hole with 20" casing string from 1208 m to 1195 m and broke out joint with damaged box threads, laid down same to deck.
Picked up and made up new 20" casing joint and ran in hole to 1208 meter.
Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment.
Prepared backup wellhead on HTS, made up same to running tool.
Picked up and made up backup wellhead assembly.
Installed  plug set in backup wellhead assembly.

Not able to make up flange between riser joints due to studs too long.
Technical Team fabricated spacer washer for shimming hydraulic jacks.

Meanwhile:
Rigged up wires for guide line system in moonpool.
Prepared next riser joints on cantilever deck.

Broke out connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and inspected same.
Found o-ring missing.
Installed o-ring in outer groove.
Made up connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and re-tested same to 35 bar, test ok.

Waited on weather.
Not able to back load cuttings from ISO tanks to supply vessel due to heavy wind and sea.

Meanwhile:
Circulated hole clean at 1500 meter with 4300 liter/min, 248 bar.
Pulled back into shoe.
Circulated with 1440 liter/min, 35 bar.
Picked up and racked back 5 1/2" DP.

Waited on weather.
Not able to back load cuttings from ISO tanks to supply vessel due to heavy wind and sea.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1440 liter/min, 35 bar.
Picked up and racked back 5 1/2" DP, 23 stands racked back.

Waited on weather to back load cuttings.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1420 lpm,  33 bar, 0 rpm.

Troubleshoot drawwork failure.

Meanwhile: 
Removed auto slips and lowered 14" casing hanger below rotary in a controlled sequence, Up/Dw weight 430/320 MT. Installed master bushing and made up circulation swedge. Circulated with 200 lpm, 9 bar, 14" casing shoe at 2433 m.
Troubleshoot SoundTrack tool. POOH to 7 m and plugged into OnTrack tool, verified software communication.
Troubleshoot de-coding problem with MWD tools.

Pulled out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4562m MD to 4467m MD. Took 5MT overpull at 4467m MD. Attempted to pass restriction several times with maximum 30MT - no go. Attempted to run in hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly with up to 40 MT - no go. Established circulation with 1300 lpm and 54 bar, no losses. Attempted to establish rotation - no go. 

Applied full string weight, and established rotation. Reamed stand down from 4467m MD to 4482m MD. Attempted to ream stand up several times - no go. Stalled out at 4467m MD.
Stopped rotation and circulation and attempted to pull 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly out of hole from 4467m MD - no go. Established rotation with 50 rpm. Got passed restriction.

Pulled / reamed out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4467m MD to 4407m MD with 1400 lpm, 31 bar, 50 rpm and 16-30 kNm. Observed tight spots at 4468m and 4460m.

Pumped 11.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Mixed and pumped 10 m3 of 1.90 sg cement slurry. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 890 l of drill water. Reset stroke counters. Pumped 2.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Displaced the cement with 40.6 m3 (1833 strokes) of 1.32 sg OBM. Underdisplaced with 2.5m3.

Rotated with 20 rpm and 15 kNm during displacement.

Waited on cement.

Meanwhlie: Performed prejob meeting prior to pick up and make up BOP test tool. Removed PS21 slips and installed master bushings. Picked up and made up BOP test tool, removed protective tape and inspected seals. Ran in hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe to wellhead at 138m MD. Displaced riser and surface lines to sea water.

Pressure tested BOP to 345 bar.  Pressure tested standpipe manifold to 345 bar.

Displaced BOP to surface to 1.32 sg OBM. Pulled out of hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 138 m MD. Broke out and laid down same.

Troubleshooting on top drive encoder. Function tested same. Function tested 3 1/2" auto slips. Performed general maintanence and housekeeping.

Kicked off to F-11 A by drilling from 2578m MD to 2586m MDwith 1800 lpm, 120 bar and 60 rpm. 50% cement / formation in returns verified at 2586m MD.

****Transferred operations to F-11 A****
